TranscribeBee — Online Audio & Video Transcription, $2/hr

# Transcribe Audio & Video to Text for $2/hr

Drop your audio or video, pay $2 per hour, and get an accurate transcript with speaker labels in any language. No strings attached.

## See it in action

Here's what you get — speaker labels, timestamps, and multiple download formats. Try it with your own file.

txt Plain text, for anything

srt Subtitles, ready for video

vtt Web captions, ready for HTML5

docx Word, for editing and sharing

pdf Print-ready, page-numbered

## How to transcribe audio or video in three steps

01

### Upload Your File

Drag and drop your audio or video. MP3, WAV, M4A, MP4, FLAC, OGG — all supported.

02

### Pay Per Hour

Just $2 per hour of audio. No subscriptions, no monthly fees. You only pay when you transcribe.

03

### Get Your Transcript

Accurate text with speaker labels, ready in minutes. Copy or download instantly.

No subscriptions. No tiers. Pay for what you use.

- —$2 minimum per file A 40-minute interview is $2 — a 90-minute lecture is $3
- — AI-powered with speaker labels
- — Any language — auto-detected
- — Most files done in minutes
- — Files auto-deleted after processing
- — Automatic refund if it fails

## Transcription for lectures, interviews, meetings and more

Whether it's one lecture or a hundred interviews — pay only for what you transcribe.

### Students & Lectures

Record your lectures, upload the audio, and get searchable notes with speaker labels. Perfect for exam prep.

### Journalists & Interviews

Transcribe interview recordings in minutes. Speaker labels make it easy to attribute quotes accurately.

### Podcasters & Content Creators

Turn episodes into show notes, blog posts, or social media content. No monthly plan needed for occasional use.

### Meetings & Calls

Transcribe Zoom recordings, phone calls, or team meetings. Pay only for what you need — no subscription waste.

### Researchers

Transcribe research interviews, focus groups, and field recordings. Download as text for qualitative analysis.

### Legal & Medical

Transcribe depositions, patient notes, or consultations. Accurate AI transcription at a fraction of human transcription costs.

## From people who used to type this out.

> “I used to ration transcription like printer ink. At two dollars an hour I just send everything — every interview, every field note.”

Ana R. · PhD researcher

> “I publish two episodes a month. Every tool I tried wanted a $20 subscription for that. This costs me six dollars.”

Marcus T. · Podcast host

> “The speaker labels were right on the first pass. I quote people for a living — that is the whole job.”

Leah S. · Freelance journalist

What happens to your file

We keep the words, not the recording. Your file is deleted from our servers once the transcript is ready — and if a job fails, the refund is automatic.

- — Processed by OpenAI's Whisper. The same state-of-the-art engine behind the most expensive tools on the market.
- — Deleted after processing. Source audio and video are removed when transcription completes.
- — Only the text remains. Your transcript stays available to read, copy, and download.
- — Refunds are automatic. If a transcription fails on our end, the full amount comes back — no support ticket.
